item.title: Rust data pipelines keep displacing JVM stacks in ingestion workloads
item.author: J. Mercer
item.description: A survey of infrastructure teams finds Rust adoption accelerating for high-throughput ingestion, with embedded search engines like Tantivy cited as a reason teams can drop external services entirely.

item.title: vLLM ships Blackwell kernel optimizations
item.author: J. Mercer
item.description: The latest vLLM release includes attention kernels tuned for NVIDIA Blackwell consumer cards, cutting decode latency for long prompts on 16GB-class hardware.

item.title: DeepSeek opens V4 Pro weights for research use (syndicated)
item.author: Newswire
item.description: DeepSeek said researchers can request the V4 Pro checkpoints starting today. Early adopters are serving the release through vLLM at launch. Helios Labs said it will fine-tune the model for laboratory automation workloads.

item.title: Helios Labs raises Series A for autonomous lab agents
item.author: P. Anand
item.description: Helios Labs, a startup building agentic systems for wet-lab automation, announced new funding today. The company said it fine-tunes DeepSeek models for instrument control and plans to expand its perception stack next quarter.
